sources.entry: Kaleidoscope - Compare text, images, and folders.

summary.name: Kaleidoscope
summary.one_liner: Kaleidoscope is a file comparison and merge app that diffs text, images, and folders, with deep Git integration for reviewing changes and resolving conflicts.
use_cases: comparing revisions of a file over time
comparing image or design file versions
syncing or comparing two folder trees
code review of working copy changes
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a tool for comparing text files, image files, and entire folder trees. For Git users, it offers a File History view to browse and compare all revisions of a file, and a 3-way merge view that shows commits leading to a conflict along with commit messages and changes between base and each side. A code review feature shows all changes between two commits in one changeset, with live updates for the working copy and filters by modification, file type, and file name. Text compare uses character-level diffs and collapses unchanged areas; image compare offers split, blink, drag, and diff modes plus pixel comparison of formats and color profiles; folder compare allows copying items from one side to the other.
notable: Deep Git integration with File History and 3-way merge
Image compare with split, blink, drag and pixel-level comparison
Folder tree comparison with copy between sides and Quick Look
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page.
The page names no platform explicitly; macOS is inferred from the awesome-mac listing and Quick Look reference.
